verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents parsing charts and images into markdown and includes a chart-extraction example, so the core of 'figures and charts are extracted' is first-party. Nothing shows chart or figure positions traced back to the source page. Source-page provenance is documented only for tables and bounding boxes only for forms, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: VLM-generated figure descriptions, image crops of figures, page and bounding-box provenance for figures and charts, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: layout-aware OCR that turns PDFs, scans, tables, and charts into clean markdown, text, or JSON
Turn even the most complex layouts, tables, charts, handwriting, checkboxes, and images into clean markdown
